items.headline: US Pauses Airstrikes on Iran to Pursue Diplomatic Talks
items.summary: The United States military has temporarily paused its airstrikes in Iran while regional mediators push for a de-escalation agreement [1.2.1]. This diplomatic pivot comes after two weeks of heavy bombardment and widespread disruptions to maritime shipping in the Strait of Hormuz.

items.headline: Samsung and Broadcom Announce $200 Billion AI Hardware Partnership
items.summary: Samsung Electronics and Broadcom signed a strategic memorandum of understanding estimated at over $200 billion over five years to power next-generation artificial intelligence infrastructure [1.1.4]. Announced on July 25, the agreement focuses on high-bandwidth memory, two-nanometer process technology, and advanced chip packaging to meet soaring global AI demands.

items.headline: Tadej Pogačar All But Secures Historic Fifth Tour de France Victory
items.summary: Slovenian cyclist Tadej Pogačar effectively locked up his fifth Tour de France overall title after holding his massive lead through Stage 20 at Alpe d'Huez on Saturday. At 27 years old, he is set to become the youngest rider in history to win five Tour titles once he finishes Sunday's final stage in Paris.

items.headline: Marvel Studios Unveils Major Film Announcements at San Diego Comic-Con 2026
items.summary: Marvel Studios made a major return to San Diego Comic-Con's Hall H, revealing that Ryan Gosling will star in a new Ghost Rider film and David Jonsson will join Black Panther 3. The high-profile presentation also showcased exclusive footage for Avengers: Doomsday, making it the headline event of the global pop culture convention.
